title: The Graveyard Book
author: Neil Gaiman
summary: A toddler escapes the murder of his family and wanders into a graveyard, where the ghosts raise him. Nobody Owens grows up among the dead while the man who killed his family is still looking for him.
readIf: you like a warm, eerie story about growing up and finding where you belong.
skipIf: you want a plot that rushes forward, as it is episodic, with each chapter covering a new year.

pairings.reason: Another short, creepy Gaiman story that treats fear with a child's courage.
A more adult, wistful story of a child facing something older than he can understand.
The inspiration for this novel: a child raised by animals instead of ghosts.
